purpose: Teach: 菊地/平川/滝沢/小柴/志賀/齊藤/岸田/高崎

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがご友人の菊地さんと文通された
lines.en: Gran — when you were young, your father had a pen pal friendship with a man named Kikuchi.
lines.style: Soft, wondering tone. Gently probing, as if reaching back into shared memory. Measured pace, unhurried. The voice of someone genuinely curious about a piece of her past.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、平川さんと将棋を指されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and when you were young, Grandpa, you played shogi with Mr. Hirakawa, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, knowing smile in the voice. Gentle turnabout — she's matching his memory with her own. Conversational, intimate, with a small lift at the end like she's offering him back what he offered her.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがアイドルの滝沢秀明の番組を観られた
lines.en: Gran — when you were young, your father watched the idol Takizawa Hideaki's TV program.
lines.style: Same wistful register as before. A quiet smile underneath — he's enjoying the rhythm of this exchange. Slightly longer pause before each detail, as if picturing it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、小柴博士のノーベル賞受賞ニュースを観られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa — when you were young, you watched the news about Dr. Koshiba winning the Nobel Prize, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Playful but grounded. She's keeping pace with him now, each memory meeting his. Slightly teasing lilt — she knows exactly what she's doing. Warm and steady throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが志賀直哉の城の崎にてを愛読された
lines.en: Gran — when you were young, your father deeply loved reading Shiga Naoya's 'Izu no Odoriko.'
lines.style: Quieter this time, more reverent. A slower pace. He's moved into literature now — his tone deepens slightly with the weight of something literary and cherished.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、齊藤というお名前の上司に仕えられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa — when you were young, you served under a supervisor named Mr. Saito, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Still warm and playful, but with an undercurrent of genuine curiosity about his work life. A breath of affection underneath. The 'dear' carries real recognition.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが岸田一家の歴史を研究された
lines.en: Gran — when you were young, your father researched the history of the Kishida family.
lines.style: A slight shift — more specific, more grounded in concrete history. Still wistful, but there's a thread of intellectual curiosity now. Quieter, almost scholarly.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、群馬県高崎で温泉に行かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa — when you were young, you went to a hot spring in Takasaki, Gunma, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warmth swelling slightly — a memory of pleasure, of travel together perhaps. Gentle and close. The voice of someone settling into the intimacy of shared years. Trailing softly on the final word.
